notes.title: Blue Screen Error
notes.notes:
[p]hello, i recently had someone refund my game due to this blue screen error and id like to address this.

when they booted up the game they reported the game booting up to a blue screen where your cheese counter was still visible, I've been aware of this bug for a while but i thought it was just a weird one off.

[b][i]How to fix it

[/i][/b]It's a very simple fix, just update your pc as well as your graphics drivers, i believe its something to do with unreal hating old drivers. 

Luckily, if you were having this issue, it likely needed to be done anyways, have fun questing!
 [/p]

notes.title: Rat Quest Is Now Updated!!!
notes.notes:
After almost a year, rat quest is finally updated!!!

[i][u][b]New Things[/b][/u][/i]

[list]
[*] Shop - buy upgrades to make rat quest easier
[*] Secrets  - what's rat quest without it's secrets
[*] Exciting Gameplay - I've added new things to keep Rat Quest fun since the play time is much longer now!
[*] [b]C H E E S E[/b] - self explanatory 
[*] partial controller support
[*] more levels
[*] and more!!!!
[/list]

But I'm not done yet, i still have more to add!

[i][u][b]Full Controller Support[/b][/u][/i]

its not in yet because it could take a few more months and i didn't want to delay over that, so ill add it at a later date!

[i][u][b]Achievements[/b][/u][/i]

This was a requested feature that i intended to add but I'm not good with all the steam stuff, so i didn't want to delay over this either.

[i][u][b]Community items[/b][/u][/i]

This one is a tough one, i don't currently qualify and I'm not sure when (or if) i will, ill add them as soon as I can though.

That being said, Have fun!!!!

notes.title: Rat quest is now entering play testing!
notes.notes: Assuming all goes well the game will release soon! with no (ish) I'm very excited to release it, unfortunately making the game isn't all i have too do, I've got a few more things on my checklist but this is by far the biggest step so far!

notes.title: How important is controller support to you all...
notes.notes:
I'm in the final stretch here but controller support is killing me, on somethings it will work fine but then on other things it implodes on its self, i could probably get controller support working but it might take a bit longer (an extra month is likely). or i could release the game sooner but then add the rest of the controller support later.

I wanted your opinion's before i made a decision like this.

notes.title: I have been doomed to the plague
notes.notes: Of course right after posting about the update for the first time i immediately got sick. So I've Decided to take this time to ask if there was anything the community would want added to the game, this update wouldn't even be happening if it weren't for the fact that I've gotten so much support for it, so i feel it's only fair to ask what you all would like to see.

notes.title: 100 Sales Announcement!!
notes.notes:
Hello! Rat Quest has reached 100 Sales! I'm incredibly Grateful for all the support that I've gotten, i never expected a school project of mine to get as far as it has.

I've been working on a massive update / overhaul to the game for the past few months, while its not quite finished yet it is very close! I don't want to give a release date quite yet, i wanted to have this done by February but sadly I'm way off from that goal, so i don't quite trust myself to give an accurate date. I'd rather release the update when I feel its at its best, rather then releasing a half baked update.

I will take this time to reveal some off the features that are coming to the game! i figured if I'm taking as long as i am to release, it's the least i can do lol.

[u][b]NEW MENU[/b][/u]

I've gone ahead and made a new menu! as you can see there is also a new lighting system to come with the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45017381/9daa7df21a94a9e3ce14a53d519020a9c74eee4d.png[/img]

[u][b]EXCITING GAMEPLAY[/b][/u]

I Added more actual gameplay elements so that the game doesn't get stale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45017381/753aac07266158529533588683522ba488cdeaeb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45017381/c6bc1318c8cb57257b1f414b96398d959359091b.png[/img]

[u][b]SHOP[/b][/u]

i added a shop for upgrades you can buy! i wanted to add something to make the game a lot harder, and the upgrades will help make it a little bit easier. (also the worlds goofiest looking shop keeper)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45017381/37a5ead29e49b5d78156385e7efe6b2b0c2abcab.png[/img]

[u][b]YOU CAN DIE[/b][/u]

as I'm sure come of you were able to put together when you saw lasers and fire, you're able to die now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45017381/c7353752b05071ea50c62e0c24492bd7cae90782.png[/img]

[u][b]OVERALL[/b][/u]

This update will add about 20x more content to the game, if not more. I hope you all enjoy this update when its out!

Oh and of course, more secrets :)
